title: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization
description: Authorization policies, roles, and claims-based access control for ASP.NET Core.

data.text: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization provides a policy-based authorization system. It supports role-based access control (RBAC), claims-based authorization, and custom authorization handlers.

data.title: Configuring Policies

terms.definition: A set of requirements and handlers that determine access.
Authorization based on claims within the user's identity.

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Use policies over simple role checks for maintainable authorization logic.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Supports roles, claims, and custom requirements
data.takeaway: Use ASP.NET Core Authorization to protect resources with fine-grained policies.
